name: Ishita Drugs and Industries Limited
about: Ishita Drugs and Industries Limited engages in the manufacture and sale of active pharma ingredients (APIs), fine chemicals, drug intermediates, and excipients in India and internationally. The company offers Active Pharma Ingredients, such as sulfa drugs/sulfonamides, vitamins, fluoro quinolones, antibiotics, anthelmintics, iodides and citrates, food additives/excipients, and others. It also provides contract manufacturing services for various drug intermediates and fine chemicals. The company was founded in 1972 and is based in Ahmedabad, India.
